name: Santiago de Compostela (Old Town)
description: Santiago de Compostela's old town sits in Galicia, in north-west Spain, and is the destination of the Camino de Santiago pilgrimage. Its streets wind past Romanesque, Gothic and Baroque buildings, all clustered around the cathedral that holds the tomb of St James. Inside, the carved Pórtico de la Gloria is a highlight. The town was rebuilt in the 11th century after being destroyed by Muslim forces.
